bias_targets.methodology: Developing a multi-step text rewriting system to correctly inflect Arabic text for specific grammatical gender contexts (first and second person, masculine and feminine). The paper evaluates the models using M2 and BLEU scores against a gender-annotated parallel corpus (APGC). Additionally, it measures gender bias in commercial machine translation (Google Translate) by post-editing its outputs and comparing BLEU scores across different gender pairs, demonstrating a performance drop when targeting feminine grammatical preferences.
